text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-05",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-05 sets a ±1 day visit window for Visit 7.2 (Day 76), whereas Table 1 (p. 44) leaves the allowed visit window blank for V7.2 (though p. 51 allows ±24 hours for the 144 h PK sample)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-07",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-07 sets the visit window for Visit 8.1 (Day 90) to ±1 day, contradicting Table 1 (p. 44) which specifies an allowed window of ±2 days."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 27,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds the '480 h' PK timepoint while citing only the 1st-dose quote on p. 27, which stops at 240 h; the 480 h timepoint appears in the 6th-dose bullet further down on p. 27."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-10",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-10 assigns the Adverse Events (AE) form to PK subgroup visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1, contradicting Table 1 (p. 45) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), which explicitly states that at these visits no other data besides PK blood sampling will be collected."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-11",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-11 assigns the Stable Conventional Treatment (CM_STAB) form to PK subgroup visits V2.1–V2.3, V7.1–V7.3, and V8.1, contradicting Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), which states no other data will be collected at PK visits."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-23",
      "change_id": "CH-23",
      "page": 87,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-23 labels HBVRES as 'HBV (HBsAg / Anti-HBs / Anti-HBc / HBV DNA) Result', whereas Appendix 2 (p. 87) specifies only 'HBV (Hepatitis B Surface Antigen)' without mentioning Anti-HBs, Anti-HBc, or HBV DNA."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-24",
      "change_id": "CH-23",
      "page": 87,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-24 includes 'HCV RNA' in the label for HCVRES, whereas Appendix 2 (p. 87) specifies only 'HCV (Hepatitis C Antibody)'."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-33",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-33 assigns Physical Examination (PE) to V2 instead of V1.1, contradicting Table 1 (p. 45), footnote i (p. 46), and Section 7.1.2 (p. 55), which schedule PE/body weight at Visits 1, 1.1, 4, 6, 8, and 9 and not at Visit 2."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-36",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-36 assigns the combined LB form to V1 and V2, omitting V1.1; per Table 1 (p. 45), clinical laboratory tests and serum pregnancy tests are performed at V1.1 (Days -5 to -1) rather than V1, and standard clinical labs are not scheduled at V2."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-39",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-39 assigns Vital Signs (VS) to V0 and V2 and omits V1.1, contradicting Table 1 (p. 45) and Section 7.1.3 (p. 55), which require vital signs at Visits 1, 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 (not V0 or V2)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-11",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-42",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-42 assigns 12-Lead ECG (EG) only to V1, V2, V8, and V9, contradicting Table 1 (p. 45) and Section 7.1.5 (p. 55), which require ECGs at Visits 1, 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 (and not at V2)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-12",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-46",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-46 omits Visit 1 from the DIARY form assignment, missing the initial diary dispensing required at Screening (Visit 1) per Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.2 (p. 49)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-13",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-49",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-49 assigns Alcohol/Tobacco Habits and Urine Drug Screening (SU) to V0 and V1 (citing an unrelated quote on p. 45), whereas Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.1 (p. 48) schedule these assessments at Visit 1 only, not Visit 0."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-14",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-52",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-52 assigns Concomitant Medications (CM) to V0 and all PK subgroup visits (V2.1–V2.3, V7.1–V7.3, V8.1) while citing an unrelated quote; Table 1 (p. 45) does not schedule CM at V0 or PK visits, and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51) states no other data are collected at PK visits."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-15",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-53",
      "change_id": "CH-4",
      "page": 37,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-53 triggers PK subgroup visits for every subject where PKSUB = 'Yes', but Sections 3.1.2 (p. 27) and 4.2.2 (p. 37) specify that only a dynamically assigned subset of consenting Mainland China patients (24 patients, 8 per arm) actually enter the PK subgroup, and stratification data are collected at Visit 1 rather than Visit 2."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-16",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-54",
      "change_id": null,
      "page": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-54 modifies rule CMP_PK_01 without citing any protocol page, quote, or source change ID."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-17",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-55",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "The protocol is internally inconsistent on the acceptable screening endoscopy window: Inclusion Criterion 4 (p. 34) and Table 1 footnote c (p. 45) require Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation, whereas Section 6.2.2 (p. 49) states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable'."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-18",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-56",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-56 enforces an edit check when infusion duration is not equal to 2 hours, contradicting the rationale for CH-13 in Appendix 4 (p. 94), which removed the ±3 min window specifically because sites found it difficult to control dosing time within a strict tolerance."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-19",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-57",
      "change_id": null,
      "page": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-57 updates review plan SDV100 without citing any protocol page, quote, or source change ID."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-20",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "Newly added forms LB, VS, EG, PE, and SU only contain a single date or summary text item and lack structured items for actual safety and eligibility parameters required by the protocol (e.g., individual lab analytes, biomarker values, pregnancy test results, C. difficile result, vital signs measurements, body weight/height, and ECG intervals on pp. 54–56)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-21",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 55,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "The timing of the screening serum pregnancy test is inconsistent in the protocol: Table 1 (p. 45) places the pregnancy test bullet at Visit 1.1 while footnote h (p. 46) and Section 7.1.4 (p. 55) state 'Serum pregnancy test at Visit 1' and Section 6.2.2 (p. 49) lists serum beta-HCG under Visit 1.1."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Exact expression evaluation semantics for `days_between` and `hours_between` in the EDC rule engine (such as argument ordering and integer truncation vs. floating-point comparison) and whether central/local laboratory analytes are ingested via external electronic data transfers rather than eCRF fields could not be verified."
}
